validator.invalid_root_type: Payload must be a JSON object or array (received: [actual_type]).
validator.invalid_type: Field '[field]' must be of type '[expected]' (received: '[actual]' with value: [value]).
validator.invalid_custom_type: Field '[field]' must be an object matching custom struct '[type]' (received: '[actual]' with value: [value]).
validator.invalid_item_type: Item at index [index] of array '[field]' must be of type '[expected]'.
validator.unexpected_field: Undeclared field '[field]' is not allowed in this strict schema.
validator.unhandled_error_port: Node '[node_name]' failed: payload validation failed with no handler attached to the 'error' port.
triggers.event_desc: Triggers the workflow when a MELODI business event occurs (e.g. order created, contact added).
triggers.webhook_desc: Triggers the workflow upon receiving an incoming HTTP request on a dedicated URL with security options and flexible methods.
triggers.validation_mode_desc: In strict mode, any non-conforming payload will be routed to the 'error' output port.
triggers.allow_extra_fields_desc: If disabled in strict mode, undeclared fields will trigger a validation error.
triggers.payload_schema_desc: Define required fields and expected types (e.g. order_id as number, customer as object).
triggers.test_payload_desc: Simulated data used exclusively for testing the workflow in the Builder. Never executed in production.
